import gzip, re, collections
p='MANE.GRCh38.v1.3.refseq_genomic.gtf.gz'
std={f'chr{i}' for i in range(1,23)}|{'chrX','chrY'}
counts=collections.Counter(); tx=collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)
for line in gzip.open(p,'rt'):
    if line.startswith('#'): continue
    f=line.rstrip('\\n').split('\\t')
    chrom,typ,attrs=f[0],f[2],f[8]
    if chrom not in std: continue
    m=re.search(r'transcript_id \"(["'^"]*)"'"',attrs); tid=m.group(1) if m else ''
    mane='tag \"MANE Select\"' in attrs
    if typ=='transcript': counts[('transcript',mane)]+=1
    if mane: counts[(typ,'mane')]+=1; tx[tid][typ]+=1
print('standard feature counts:',counts)
print('standard MANE tx:',len(tx))
print('feature tx count ranges')
for typ in ['transcript','exon','CDS','start_codon','stop_codon']:
    vals=[c[typ] for c in tx.values()]
    print(typ,len(vals),sum(vals),min(vals) if vals else None,max(vals) if vals else None,collections.Counter(vals).most_common(8))
print('mane transcripts without CDS:',sum('CDS' not in c for c in tx.values()))
print('mane transcripts transcript-line:',sum(c['transcript'] for c in tx.values()))
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import gzip,re,collections,numpy as np
p='MANE.GRCh38.v1.3.refseq_genomic.gtf.gz'; std={f'chr{i}' for i in range(1,23)}|{'chrX','chrY'}
rxa=re.compile(r'(\\w+) \"(["'^"]*)"'"')
tx={}; fs=collections.defaultdict(lambda:collections.defaultdict(list))
for ln in gzip.open(p,'rt'):
 if ln.startswith('#'): continue
 f=ln.rstrip().split('\\t'); ch,ft=f[0],f[2]
 if ch not in std: continue
 a=dict(rxa.findall(f[8])); tid=a.get('transcript_id','')
 if ft=='transcript' and 'tag \"MANE Select\"' in f[8]: tx[tid]=(ch,f[6])
 if tid: fs[tid][ft].append((int(f[3]),int(f[4])))
for addstop in [False,True]:
 out=[]
 for tid,(ch,strand) in tx.items():
  ex=fs[tid]['exon']; cds=fs[tid]['CDS']+(fs[tid]['stop_codon'] if addstop else [])
  lo=min(x[0] for x in cds); hi=max(x[1] for x in cds)
  p5=p3=0
  for s,e in ex:
   left=max(0,min(e,lo-1)-s+1); right=max(0,e-max(s,hi+1)+1)
   if strand=='+':p5+=left;p3+=right
   else:p5+=right;p3+=left
  out.append([p5,sum(e-s+1 for s,e in cds),p3])
 print('stop',addstop,'n',len(out),'med',np.median(np.array(out),axis=0),'floor',np.floor(np.median(np.array(out),axis=0)).astype(int))
PY"
